source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 27ης Μαρτίου — «Όσιος Ευτύχιος»

attestations.note: The page gives one sentence, «Ο Όσιος Ευτύχιος απεβίωσε ειρηνικά», and a couplet, and nothing else: no place, no year, no office, no hymn. The line carries no epithet either, so the day is all that distinguishes him; the display name says so. Checked against every Eutychius the corpus holds — of Constantinople, of Melitene, of Nursia, of the Forty of Sebaste, the companion of Bassus, the martyr of 2 September and the subdeacon of 26 March — and none of them is a venerable kept on 27 March with no other data.
